text.div:
Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ng-hiv-eac-form-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-hiv-eac-form-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
adherence-good GoodThe client demonstrates good adherence to the prescribed ART regimen.
adherence-fair FairThe client demonstrates fair adherence to the prescribed ART regimen.
adherence-poor PoorThe client demonstrates poor adherence to the prescribed ART regimen.
barrier-forgot ForgotThe client forgot to take one or more prescribed ART doses.
barrier-knowledge-beliefs Knowledge or beliefsKnowledge, understanding or beliefs affect the client's adherence.
barrier-side-effects Side effectsActual or anticipated medication side effects affect adherence.
barrier-physical-illness Physical illnessPhysical illness affects the client's ability or willingness to take ART.
barrier-substance-use Substance useAlcohol or other substance use affects adherence.
barrier-depression DepressionDepression or depressive symptoms affect adherence.
barrier-pill-burden Pill burdenThe number, size or frequency of medicines affects adherence.
barrier-lost-ran-out-of-drugs Lost or ran out of drugsThe client lost the medicines or exhausted the supply before the next refill.
barrier-transport TransportTransport availability or cost affects access to ART services or medicines.
barrier-child-refusing Child refusingA child refuses to take the prescribed ART medicines.
barrier-scheduling SchedulingThe client's daily schedule or medication schedule affects adherence.
barrier-fear-of-disclosure Fear of disclosureFear that the client's HIV status may be disclosed affects adherence.
barrier-family-partner Family or partnerA family or partner-related issue affects adherence.
barrier-food-insecurity Food insecurityLack of reliable access to adequate food affects adherence.
barrier-drug-stock-out Drug stock-outThe medicine was unavailable because of a facility or supply-chain stock-out.
barrier-long-waiting-time Long waiting timeLong waiting time at the service-delivery point affects adherence.
barrier-stigma StigmaExperienced or anticipated HIV-related stigma affects adherence.
barrier-other Other barrierAn adherence barrier not represented by another code; specify separately.
service-education EducationEducation was provided to address adherence needs.
service-individual-counselling Individual counsellingIndividual adherence counselling was provided.
service-group-counselling Group counsellingGroup adherence counselling was provided.
service-peer-support Peer supportPeer-based adherence support was provided.
service-treatment-buddy Treatment buddyA treatment buddy was established or supported.
service-extended-drug-pick-up Extended drug pick-upAn extended medicine pick-up arrangement was provided.
service-community-art-group Community ART groupThe client was linked to or supported through a community ART group.
service-directly-observed-therapy Directly observed therapyDirect observation of treatment was provided or arranged.
service-other Other service interventionA service intervention not represented by another code; specify separately.
tool-pill-box Pill boxA pill box was provided or recommended as an adherence aid.
tool-calendar CalendarA calendar was provided or recommended as an adherence aid.
tool-incentive-calendar-paediatric Incentive calendar (paediatric)A paediatric incentive calendar was provided or recommended.
tool-arv-swallowing-instruction ARV swallowing instructionInstruction on swallowing or administering ARV medicines was provided.
tool-written-instructions Written instructionsWritten medication or adherence instructions were provided.
tool-phone-call-sms Phone calls or SMSPhone calls or SMS messages were used or planned as adherence reminders.
tool-alarms AlarmsAn alarm or electronic reminder was used or recommended.
tool-other Other intervention toolAn adherence tool not represented by another code; specify separately.

title: NG HIV Enhanced Adherence Counselling Form Codes
